title: Structured somatic harm and noxious-input substrate
scope: A factual event and persistence model for explicit noxious bodily stimuli and injuries in Cy's represented prison world.

scientific_boundary.pain: A personal sensory and emotional experience associated with, or resembling that associated with, actual or potential tissue damage.
scientific_boundary.nociception: Neural encoding of noxious stimuli. Cy has no biological nociceptors, so the implementation is only a computational functional analogue of incoming nociceptive information.
scientific_boundary.noxious_stimulus: A stimulus represented as capable of causing tissue damage. Capability is stored categorically and is not inferred from prose.
implemented: persistent injury identity and follow-up ledger
functional computational analogue of incoming nociceptive information

sources.citation: International Association for the Study of Pain. IASP Terminology.
sources.use: Terminological boundary between Pain, nociception and noxious stimuli. The software does not claim a biological process.

sources.citation: Garland EL. Pain Processing in the Human Nervous System: A Selective Review of Nociceptive and Biobehavioral Pathways. Prim Care. 2012;39(3):561-571. doi:10.1016/j.pop.2012.06.013.
sources.use: Supports treating nociceptive pathways and the multidimensional experience of Pain as non-identical. No anatomical activation mapping was derived.

sources.citation: Woller SA, Eddinger KA, Corr M, Yaksh TL. An Overview of Pathways Encoding Nociception. Clin Exp Rheumatol. 2017;35 Suppl 107(5):40-46.
sources.use: Supports the mechanical, thermal and chemical modality vocabulary and the distinction between peripheral input and distributed processing. No biological pathway equation was copied.

sources.citation: Chen ZS, Wang J. Pain, from perception to action: A computational perspective. iScience. 2023;26(1):105707. doi:10.1016/j.isci.2022.105707.
sources.use: Documents computational perspectives linking perception, inference and action. Predictive inference and action selection remain explicitly unimplemented here.

sources.citation: Lang VA, Lundh T, Ortiz-Catalan M. Mathematical and Computational Models for Pain: A Systematic Review. Pain Med. 2021;22(12):2806-2817. doi:10.1093/pm/pnab177.
sources.use: Shows heterogeneous mathematical approaches and no single accepted universal Pain equation. This implementation therefore introduces no Pain magnitude equation.

rules: A stimulus and an injury are separate records.
A stimulus ending never resolves an injury.
Only confirmed structured tissue damage creates an injury ledger record.
Only an explicit structured resolution naming an existing injury closes it.
Elapsed time does not imply healing.
A PHYSICAL_HARM binary outcome cannot invent body site, modality, injury type, duration or subjective Pain.
Generated prose is not admissible evidence.

numerical_inventory.basis: ENGINEERING VERSION IDENTIFIER; not a scientific parameter

numerical_inventory.role: number of recent somatic events included in the public snapshot; the complete ledger remains persisted and owner-inspectable
